notes: Migrated WinUI 3 app builds clean (0 errors) and launches (PID 29896, owns top-level window). All 6 scenarios reach 100% structural control coverage. Enable/Disable controls are non-responsive in BOTH the original UWP golden and the WinUI candidate because this machine has no accelerometer (status reads 'Standard accelerometer not found'); since the controls are equally dead in the UWP ground truth, this is a legitimate hardware gate, not a behavioral regression. Visual fidelity confirmed by eye on scenarios 1, 2, and 5: identical nav list, scenario titles, descriptions, 'Standard' dropdown, Enable/Disable buttons, 'No data' outputs, and the red 'Standard accelerometer not found' status bar. The WinUI app additionally renders a clean defensive fallback message. Capture quirk: scenario 2 ('Data events') title-nav was ambiguous and stayed on scenario 1 in BOTH captures (symmetric tool artifact, not a migration defect); structural coverage was still graded 2/2 from the UIA tree.
